pack_identity.rule: Pack + ContainerWithContents必须声明OperationDefinition.pack_identity，output_role精确指向唯一实际输出角色；container_material_roles和content_roles均非空、各自不重复且互斥，恰好覆盖全部inputs角色；不按英文角色名、顺序或输出类型推断。一次实际装盒产生新容器ID，包装材料源保留ID及来源关系但转为transformed，内容保留原ID/类型/质量/组成并将唯一holder变为该容器；容器composition_refs只记录包装材料，contents只记录内容。内容仍是物理对象但不重复算外部自由库存/库位空间，空盒源不再算现有库存；输出类型/数量/单位与质量取实际输出声明，内容单位不改成箱单位。缺映射或不一致允许保存草稿，但阻止该工序执行并定位pack_identity；非Pack不得借该字段改变身份。现有carton-pack/parameterized-pack显式contents_from=product、container_material_from=carton映射为output_role=package/container_material_roles=[carton]/content_roles=[product]，该已知来源映射不推广成按名称猜测规则。

manual_acceptance_goal_contract.source: Explicit manual no-order acceptance declaration, independently saved with the selected Scenario through existing PutObject Scenario
manual_acceptance_goal_contract.compatibility: Absent or null reads as no manual goal; None omits the new field on write to preserve exact legacy Scenario shape. Some writes the complete explicit goal. No new operation or fake GenerationContext/OrderLine.
manual_acceptance_goal_contract.selection: A supplied manual goal must agree exactly with any genuine frozen GenerationContext.goal and internal explicit goal. Conflict blocks enqueue; OrderLines and a manual goal are mutually exclusive.
manual_acceptance_goal_contract.freeze: The exact selected Scenario revision containing acceptance_goal is saved in RunInputRef.frozen_scenario_file; later goal edits form a new Scenario/Project revision and never change old Run/stock/events.
manual_acceptance_goal_contract.execution: Exact product revision/unit/destination/stage/window, positive optional target and declared calendar are checked before enqueue by the same Engine. No inference from device name, output, missing goal, latest source or target quantity.
manual_acceptance_goal_contract.quantity: Target controls only full-window goal comparison, never caps production, stock, arrivals or cumulative acceptance. Per-day conclusions require the explicitly declared daily observation basis; short cases prove only their stated finite window.
manual_acceptance_goal_contract.history: Goal acceptance records have nonempty real accepted items and order_id=null; no synthetic order/allocation/allow_partial/GenerationContext.

order_transport_execution_contract.compatibility: New empty arrays omit on write and absent reads empty; all previous no-choice/no-phase inputs retain their exact shape. The existing default source and whole-trip resources are unchanged.

operation_choice.selection: For each RouteStep, use exactly its operation_ref if it matches the current explicit default/inline source or an explicitly listed route_operation_refs entry. Additional entries are exact loaded Operations modules, never latest/category/name fallback.
operation_choice.physical_owner: All alternatives remain the same DeviceInstance and execution_capacity ResourceInstance; no second physical Assembly, clock, inventory or capacity.
operation_choice.per_job: Every actual Job records its one selected exact source. Material roles, ports, parameters, family, duration and readiness come from that definition and the explicit step bindings; do not merge different source trees.
operation_choice.validation: Missing/mismatched/duplicate choice, unsupported category, incompatible material/resource/unit/parameter or binding cannot execute. Existing professional producer/purpose/binding/selected-input authorization is not granted by this list; an actual professional operation must still match its real consumer gate.

transport_resources.resources: Existing resources remain held for the whole actual trip, including declared waits and return; no role name is reinterpreted into a phase.
transport_resources.loading_resources: Acquire only for actual loading; release on loading completion. Waiting does not manufacture elapsed work or cargo.
transport_resources.unloading_resources: Acquire only for actual unloading; retain cargo and whole-trip resources while unavailable/blocked, release the phase requirement on completion.
transport_resources.binding: All tables use explicit ResourceRequirement.role through SupplyRelation.resources to actual resources with exact quantity units/qualification/calendar. Roles may have arbitrary names; no loader/unloader string inference.
transport_resources.aliases: Same physical resource aliased within one trip merges overlapping declared requirements by maximum, as existing job/phase rules; independent jobs/trips still compete on aggregate actual capacity.
transport_resources.boundaries: Existing declared stage times and non-preemptive conditions remain; zero-duration stages cannot claim a closed calendar boundary. Unknown durations/resources remain named gaps, not zero/default availability.

explicit_quality_reinspection_contract.consumer: Unique Engine starts a distinct actual inspection attempt on the same physical item and exact inspection definition. It acquires actual resources and honors duration/preset cursor; pending-store item is not removed before its real check can start; hold-station handoff is atomic.
explicit_quality_reinspection_contract.semantics: Reinspection performs a new check; it is not rework and does not increment completed_reworks. Previous completed attempt stays completed. UNKNOWN remains pending; actual rejected recheck follows declared finite-rework/isolation policy. It does not grant professional acknowledgment or manufacture a human decision.
explicit_quality_reinspection_contract.state_and_storage: No new QualityDecision payload or independent quality state. Existing declared preset/human/provider source, exact refs, time, archive, frozen Scenario and event contracts remain.
explicit_quality_reinspection_contract.wire_version: Existing API0.1/schema1.0 unchanged; all existing enum strings remain unchanged.
explicit_quality_reinspection_contract.verification: Root Schema cases cover explicit reinspect and rejection of invented automatic_pass; actual Engine behavior is owned by W3 and independent W5 consumers, not inferred from type parsing.
